episode_event_salon_pasiosalon_date_ch03: One day...

Thanks for going shopping with me,
[Name:PlayerNickname ].

Now that I have all the ingredients, it’s time
to get cooking!
Hm? What am I making?
My signature croissant curry, of course!

I’ve met lots of people on Pasio who have
helped me, so I wanna repay their kindness!
That’s not the only reason, though.

There’s something else I wanna do for the
people here.

I’m thinking someday, I could start a hotel on
Pasio for sync pairs to stay at.

There are lots of Trainers on this island who
help people out other than Team MZ, right?

Hotel Z was a lifesaver for me back in
Lumiose. I felt taken care of there.

It’d be nice if all the sync pairs who came to
Pasio had a place like that to take it easy.

So whenever I open my hotel on Pasio,
would you mind helping me out with it,
[Name:PlayerNickname ]?
(Say of course you’ll help.)

Always willing without a second thought,
huh. I knew I could count on you!
(Joke that it depends on the reward.)
Well, THAT depends on how hard you work!

Either way, I bet it’ll take a while to make it
happen.

For now, thanks for your help today! I’ll
definitely repay you, so look forward to it!

A little while after helping Urbain with his
shopping...

Sorry to spring this on you, but are you
free tomorrow?

If so, keep your day open! I wanna repay
you for earlier!

[Name:PlayerNickname ] went to where
Urbain specified...

Greetings, valued guest. Welcome to my
humble establishment, Hotel Z Pasio.

The hotel has been exclusively reserved for
you today, so please make yourself at home
and enjoy your stay.
Surprise!

I got Lear to help me try that hotel plan
I told you about!
Its name? Hotel Z, of course!

Just like the Hotel Z that supported me back
in Lumiose...

I’m hoping my hotel here can prop up lots of
people.
If I ever open a real Hotel Z on Pasio...

I want you to be the first guest,
[Name:PlayerNickname ].
(Say that’s a great idea.)
I know, right? I just knew you’d say that!
(Say it’d be an honor.)

Hearing that from you makes me want to try
even harder!
Today’s just a test run...

but hearing you cheer me on makes me think
I could truly open a Hotel Z on Pasio.
So I hope you’ll keep supporting me!

All right! Now that I’m feeling pumped,
it’s time for some hospitality!

As thanks for earlier, I made my signature
dish.
Without further ado...

Valued guest—please enjoy the hotel’s
prized croissant curry!
